---
title: Install
description: Add the theme, with smalldocs or with Quarto.
---

The theme is one folder, `_extensions/tufte/`. It holds a stylesheet for each
mode, the ET Book fonts, and the same rules written for Quarto.

## With smalldocs

```sh
smalldocs add rahuldave/smalldocs-tufte
```

This copies the folder into `_extensions/tufte/` and notes where it came from.
Then name the theme in `_smalldocs.yml`:

```yaml
theme: tufte
```

In a `_quarto.yml`, the line goes under `smalldocs:`, which Quarto ignores:

```yaml
smalldocs:
  theme: tufte
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Keep it up to date
`smalldocs themes` lists the themes of a project, with the command that
fetches each one again.
:::

## With Quarto

```sh
quarto add rahuldave/smalldocs-tufte
```

```yaml
format:
  tufte-html:
    toc: true
```

## On any Bootstrap page

Each stylesheet is a whole Bootstrap 5.3 with the Tufte rules after it, as a
Bootswatch theme is. So a page that links to `tufte.css` in place of
`bootstrap.min.css` gets the theme. Keep the `et-book` folder next to it.
